head: Galaxy AI Premium: Samsung may charge $4.99 a month for new AI features
dek: Code in One UI 9.5 points to a Galaxy AI Premium plan for $4.99 a month or $47.99 a year, SammyGuru found. Today's Galaxy AI features would stay free.
details: The paid plan would add new features such as Bixby Action, which works across your apps, and Gen Video, which makes videos from your photos, plus higher usage limits. Credit packs would add more usage for a one-time fee. Samsung hasn't announced it.
where: Galaxy phones with One UI 9.5, not announced
means: Samsung's AI features may split into free ones you have now and paid new ones.
todo: Nothing to do now; current features such as Now Brief and the keyboard's AI tools stay free.
